Title: One Fine Day

Cast

1. Tanay - 8 years, son
Look: glasses, green shirt, black trousers
2. Ananya - 12 years, daughter
Look: green salwar-kurta, short hair
3. Hema - 37 years, mother
Look: yellow kurta, jeans
4. Vinod - 45 years, father
Look: blue shirt, black trousers
5. Sharda - 67 years, grandmother
Look: pale blue saree, white hair

Places

1. The park - green grass, swings, benches
2. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window
3. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant

Scene 1: The park - Day

[Tanay stands in the park. Ananya, Hema and Vinod stand near him.]

Hema: "Tanay, what's the plan today?"

[Tanay goes jogging in the park.]

Hema: "That's easy."

[Tanay catches the ball.]

Vinod: "Slowly, take it easy."

[Tanay swings on the swing.]

Tanay (happily): "Show me too!"

[Tanay plays on the see-saw with Mother.]

Vinod (happily): "That was fun!"

[Tanay feeds the birds.]

Tanay (excited): "Show me too!"

[Tanay does push-ups.]

Tanay: "One more time!"

[Ananya skips rope.]

Tanay: "Show me too!"

Scene 2: The living room - Day

[Tanay stands in the living room. Hema, Ananya and Vinod stand near him.]

Ananya: "Dad, look over here."

[Tanay eats his breakfast at the table.]

Tanay (softly): "Oh wow!"

[Tanay takes a bite of his sandwich.]

Hema: "Slowly, take it easy."

[Tanay munches on an apple.]

Ananya: "This is amazing!"

[Tanay drinks a glass of water.]

Hema (gently): "Oh wow!"

[Tanay sips hot tea from a cup.]

Ananya: "How beautiful!"

Scene 3: The courtyard - Day

Hema: "Vinod, look over here."

[Tanay walks across the courtyard.]

Tanay: "Yes, of course."

[Tanay runs to Mother.]

Vinod: "I knew it!"

[Tanay jumps with joy.]

Tanay: "That's easy."

[Tanay tiptoes across the courtyard.]

Tanay: "Hey, look at that!"

[Tanay climbs the stairs to the terrace.]

Tanay: "How beautiful!"

[Tanay searches for his lost ball.]

Tanay: "Really?"

[Tanay peeks out from behind the door.]

Vinod (excited): "Let's do this again tomorrow!"
